messages:
Mira (CS): Quick check — Peregrine's renewal coming up. They're asking to change invoice currency to EUR and move to a 9-month term. They also need e-sign and procurement PO. Has anyone started the amendment draft?
Sam A. (AE): Yep, spoke to Alex yesterday. They prefer 9mo to align with fiscal quarters. Procurement asked for NET45 payment terms and company billing entity = Peregrine Holdings GmbH.
Alex (Peregrine): Confirmed — we'll send PO for EUR billing, VAT ID will be provided. Targeting PO by EOD Friday.
Jordan (RevOps): Ok — this is two changes: term length + currency. We should do an amendment (billing addendum) not a new contract. I'll create amendment with proration clause. Anyone object to 9mo with prorated first invoice?
Linda (Finance): No objection. Quick notes: our billing system needs these fields: currency=EUR, invoice_entity=Peregrine Holdings GmbH, vat_id=DE123456789, payment_terms=NET45, tax_handling=customer. Also confirm whether they want amounts in EUR or EUR with USD converted back for reporting.
Mira (CS): They want EUR-native invoices. Also, procurement asked for "PO number on invoice header" and invoice email billing@peregrine.example
Sam A. (AE): I'll nudge Alex for VAT ID and PO format. Alex — can you confirm invoice email and whether legal needs a secondary signatory?
Alex (Peregrine): Invoice email is billing@peregrine.example. VAT ID I'll send in the PO. Legal signature: only CFO signs.
LegalBot: Automation: Use DocuSign template id: tpl_2024_renewal_amend. Sig flow recommended: customer CFO -> Redwood exec (standard). If any special clauses (data processing, termination) need legal review, tag @legal-team.
Jordan (RevOps): Drafting amendment now. Here's the first pass header we can paste into DocuSign:
```
Amendment: Change term length to 9 months
Billing currency: EUR
Payment terms: NET45
Proration: First invoice prorated to start date
Invoice entity: Peregrine Holdings GmbH
PO required on invoice header
```
Mira (CS): LGTM. @Linda (Finance) can you confirm running balance sync won't break when currency is EUR?
Linda (Finance): We'll need to create EUR ledger for this customer. I'll do the setup but need confirmation of GL code — use GL-4209 for SaaS revenue EUR.
Sam A. (AE): Sending Alex the draft now. Also need final pricing lines (seat counts + overage). @Mira can you confirm current seats 20 and renewal price same as last year?
Mira (CS): Seats = 20, renewal list price unchanged. Offer is 9mo at 75% of annual prorated (per playbook). I'll attach pricing calc.
Mira (CS): Pricing calc:
```
20 seats x €120/month = €2400/mo
9 months = €21,600
Applied renewal discount = 25% -> €16,200
```
Alex (Peregrine): That looks right. We'll include PO for €16,200 EUR. Expect PO Friday.
Jordan (RevOps): Great. I'll create amendment in DocuSign using tpl_2024_renewal_amend and route to Alex (CFO) then Redwood signing exec. I'll add caveat: invoices will be issued monthly starting on renewal date.
Linda (Finance): Once DocuSign is routed, please cc billing@redwood.example so we can link invoice schedule.
Mira (CS): Thanks team. Follow-ups: Jordan to send DocuSign, Sam to confirm PO when received, Linda to set up EUR ledger. @legal-team watch for any changes. :thumbsup:
Sam A. (AE): noted, I'll ping here when PO arrives.
LegalBot: DocuSign envelope created: env_987654321. Status: waiting for customer signature.
Mira (CS): Closing loop — flagging as renewal at risk until PO done. Will update status in Gainsight. Thanks.
